spc.label: Statistical Process Monitoring (SPM)
spc.query: (((ti:"control chart" OR abs:"control chart") OR (ti:"statistical process monitoring" OR abs:"statistical process monitoring" OR ti:"statistical process control" OR abs:"statistical process control") OR ((ti:"process monitoring" OR abs:"process monitoring") AND (cat:stat.ME OR cat:stat.AP))) OR (ti:"time between events") OR ((abs:"out-of-control" OR abs:"control limits" OR abs:"profile monitoring" OR ti:"profile monitoring" OR ti:"monitoring method" OR abs:Shewhart OR abs:EWMA) AND (cat:stat.ME OR cat:stat.AP OR cat:stat.CO OR cat:stat.OT OR cat:stat.ML OR cat:math.ST)))
